identity_linkage_inputs: A2 birth date derived from DATE
Wikidata QID candidate search labels/matched text

candidate_metadata.birth_date_requirement: P569 precision >= day and absolute date difference <= 1 day

name_rules.normalization: Unicode NFKD; remove diacritics; lowercase; non-alnum to spaces; collapse spaces
name_rules.EXACT_TOKEN_SIGNATURE: sorted normalized token lists exactly equal
name_rules.SUBSET_TOKEN_MATCH: one token set is subset of the other, at least 2 shared tokens, smaller/larger coverage >= 2/3

resolution_rule: reject candidates with birth-date difference > 1 day
reject candidates without eligible name match
rank remaining by exact birth date over +/-1 day, then exact token signature over subset token match
link only if the highest rank is unique; otherwise AMBIGUOUS
outcome_rule: No P570 or other death/outcome field may be queried until A2_identity_links.csv is SHA-256 frozen.
go_no_go_after_stage_a: Inspect blind linkage coverage before any death-truth query. Do not tune using outcomes.
